scope: Latest successful cloud native build and committed source comparison; no deployment or store mutation.

latest_native_build.evidence_method: GitHub connector run/job/artifact metadata and the verifier JSON printed in successful cloud job logs; exact-commit verifier/build source inspected. No artifact binaries or archive manifest downloaded, and no local binary rehash performed.

source_equivalence.comparison_method: git diff --quiet on the listed paths, plus identical git tree IDs for apps/esha.
source_equivalence.scope_limit: Comparison covers the two named commits only. It does not validate later or uncommitted edits, backend AI changes, Apple listing operations, or signed store builds.

historical_checkpoints.scope: Earlier native artifact hashes, backend deployment receipt, source-only membership checks, Apple identity screenshots and failed signing attempt; retained as historical evidence, not current service/store status.

apple_release_order: Resolve the existing Apple authentication failure and verify the intended Esha app record.
Run esha-apple-draft-listing and verify version 1.0.0 before the first IPA upload; the helper refuses the 1.0 rename after a build exists.
Prepare and verify the Esha-specific profile, then build and verify the signed candidate before upload.
